about: Project invariants for global/scripts/h3_compile.py. Each one is stated once in the compiled prompt: identity and wardrobe in retention_analysis, style before [Shot 1], setting at its first appearance, object-state locks on the first shot where that state applies.
style: The target video is a 2D television sports-anime episode in a landscape 16:9 frame, with bold clean inked linework, controlled cel shading and simplified hand-painted backgrounds.
Character animation is stepped and expressive at natural action speed; no photorealism, 3D rendering or photographic depth of field.

@kaiden.definition: @kaiden (Kaiden), the twelve-year-old boy with short spiky navy hair, a plain pocketless cobalt-blue T-shirt, black athletic shorts with white side stripes and blue-white sneakers
@kaiden.retain: Kaiden's face, navy hair and wardrobe are retained; the T-shirt stays plain and pocketless, the only pocket is the right side seam of his shorts, and he carries no bag

@ima.definition: @ima (Eema), the brown-haired adult woman in the front-view teal blazer, white blouse, dark knee-length skirt and black shoes
@ima.retain: Eema's face, brown hair and front-view teal blazer outfit are retained; the alternate rear-view wardrobe on the sheet is not used

@nanao.definition: @nanao (Nanao), the dark-haired boy in the green T-shirt, grey shorts and navy-white sneakers
@nanao.retain: Nanao's face, hair and wardrobe are retained

@mocha.definition: @mocha (Mocha), the brown-haired boy in the white emblem T-shirt, dark cargo trousers and white sneakers
@mocha.retain: Mocha's face, hair and wardrobe are retained

@beyblade.definition: @beyblade, Kaiden's palm-sized handmade top with a blue-red metal attack ring, weathered silver metal, a brown wooden lower ring, visible screws, a central bit chip and a conical metal tip
@beyblade.retain: the top's exact layers, colors and screws are retained; before the emblem discovery its centre shows three plain ink strokes, and the physical top never glows

@breakfast_plate.definition: @breakfast_plate, the plate of breakfast Eema prepared
@breakfast_plate.retain: the plate and food design are retained

@phone.retain: the phone's design is retained; its screen shows content only toward its viewer

@kaidens_house.retain: the room layout is retained: bed on the left, workbench on the right, doorway screen right

@kaidens_house.geography: with the bed on the left, the workbench on the right and the doorway screen right

byScene.SC002: Rain falls in the monsoon night outside; the room stays dry and lit by a blue-grey lamp
byScene.SC003: Steady monsoon rain falls past the window under dense overcast; the room stays dry, lit by soft window daylight with warm skin tones

ambience.SC003: Steady rain on the tin roof, a ceiling-fan hum and quiet room tone continue throughout; a distant television murmurs from another room.

stateLocks.text: @beyblade is not spinning; it rests where it lies and moves only when a hand moves it.
@beyblade spins continuously on its tip with circumferential blur, precessing and losing speed only through friction and contact.
The top sits flush against the launcher underside with no gap, tip down, and the short rigid toothed ripcord is inserted through the launcher; there is no string or shaft.
